header.running_head: The Bay'ah of Children who Had Not Yet Come of Age

Hadhrat Hind (RA) grabbed hold of Rasulullaah ﷺ's hand and pleaded her case. When Rasulullaah ﷺ asked her if she was indeed Hind, she said, "May Allaah forgive what has happened in the past."

Rasulullaah ﷺ then turned away from her (towards the other women present) and (continuing with the formal pledge of allegiance), he said, "And will not commit adultery." Hadhrat Hind (RA) said, "Does a respectable woman ever commit adultery?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "By Allaah! A respectable woman never commits adultery." Continuing further, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "And will not kill their children." Hadhrat Hind (RA) again interrupted by saying, "It was you who killed them during the Battle of Badr. However, you and they know more." Rasulullaah ﷺ completed the Bay'ah by reciting the rest of the verse, "That they will not kill their children, that they will not come forth with slander which they fabricate before their hands and legs and that they will not disobey you (O Rasulullaah ﷺ) in any good."

The narrator says that here Rasulullaah ﷺ forbade the women from wailing when someone died because during the Period of Ignorance, (when wailing) women used to tear their clothes, scratch their faces, pull their hair and pray for (their own) destruction and death.[^1]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Usayd bin Abi Usayd Barraad
blocks.text: Hadhrat Usayd bin Abi Usayd Barraad narrates from one of the women who pledged allegiance to Rasulullaah ﷺ that amongst the things that Rasulullaah ﷺ required them to pledge was that they would not disobey him in any good, would not scratch their faces, would not dishevel their hair, would not tear their collars and would not pray for destruction.[^2]
The Bay'ah of Children who Had Not Yet Come of Age
Hadhrat Hasan, Husayn, Abdullaah bin Abbaas and Abdullaah bin Ja'far (RA) Pledge Their Allegiance

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Muhammad bin Ali bin Husayn (RAH)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Muhammad bin Ali bin Husayn (RAH) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ accepted the pledge of allegiance from Hadhrat Hasan, Husayn, Abdullaah bin Abbaas and Abdullaah bin Ja'far (RA) while they were all still youngsters who had not yet grown beards or come of age. Rasulullaah ﷺ did not accept the pledge of allegiance from any other children besides those of his family.[^3]
